narration: The three notes skip from pane to pane through the fused-glass street. Most faces turn toward you. Two do not: a child crouched beneath an oilskin watches the drain grates, and a one-eyed courier with a lacquered message tube watches the black seam of cloud closing over the sea-caves. At your third note, the courier answers with three taps against the tube—not applause, but recognition. “If that was a warning,” they say, “you are late. If it was a summons, choose who you mean to save.” Wind drives the first cold rain through the tannery door, carrying the low roar of water from somewhere beneath the cobbles.

ruling.understoodAction: Use a conspicuous musical signal to identify people already focused on the approaching storm.
ruling.ruling: Ordinary observation reveals who reacts differently; no roll is needed until Mira tries to influence, deceive, or read concealed intent.
ruling.stakes: The storm is now close enough to begin affecting the street.

dmNotes: Turn 1: player-authored motif reciprocated; open handoff preserved. The courier becomes consequential and is engine-minted through gen[npc].
